tonguePlacement: Raise the tongue tip to the alveolar ridge.
airflow: Let air move around the sides of the tongue.

steps.label: Start
steps.caption: Open the mouth just enough for the tongue to rise.

steps.label: Transition
steps.caption: Lift the tongue tip behind the upper teeth.

steps.label: Release
steps.caption: Let air flow around the sides of the tongue.

steps.label: Sound
steps.caption: Keep the L clean and light.
